summary: Frontend-only UI testing for NekSathi mobile-OTP sign-in flow and QR-activation-via-OTP path. All 5 requested scenarios (plus public scan regression) passed end-to-end against the live preview URL. OTP request returns dev_code (mock mode), UI displays it in otp-dev-code, verify creates the user and issues a JWT which redirects to /dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: OtpLogin.jsx: dev_code being surfaced in UI is intended for preview mode but ensure that /api/auth/otp/request never returns dev_code once TWILIO_* env vars are set (backend guard exists per problem statement).

Claim.jsx: uses required={!!user} on plate input so logged-out submit passes HTML5 validation and triggers the OTP redirect - works, but this could confuse users if they leave the plate empty; consider always-required with an inline hint before redirect.
AuthContext: no refresh-token flow; JWT is stored in localStorage which is acceptable for MVP but flag XSS surface.
test_credentials: Admin admin@safeqr.com/admin1234, Owner demo_web@safeqr.com/demo1234, plus dynamic +9198######## phones with dev-code OTP.
seed_data_creation: Used existing unclaimed serial NS-2608-000009 from qr_inventory (no new batch needed). Created 2 OTP users during test (random +9198######## phones) and 1 vehicle (DL01 XX 1234 Honda City) claimed under serial NS-2608-000009.
context_for_next_testing_agent: OTP flow verified working. Serial NS-2608-000009 is now claimed - use /api/admin/qr/generate-bulk or fetch a fresh unclaimed serial via /api/admin/qr/inventory?status=unclaimed. Dev code appears inside data-testid=otp-dev-code as a 6-digit number (extract with regex \d{6}). Rate limits: otp-request 5/min, verify 10/min per IP - use fresh phone numbers.

test_scenarios_executed.otp_existing_user_round_trip: PASS - same phone re-verifies to same account
test_scenarios_executed.qr_activation_via_otp_logged_out: PASS - claim redirect to /otp-login?next=/claim/SERIAL, OTP completes, redirect back, submit claim-> claim-done + go-vehicle link visible
test_scenarios_executed.regression_public_scan: PASS - /scan/<qrId> loads (Wrong Parking / Accident / Theft options visible)
